title: Flutter: drag-and-drop move input + action builder
description: Translate user gestures into engine Actions. Drag piece from cell to cell → MovePiece action. Tap empty cell → Place action. Drag from hand to board → PlayCard/Place. Long-press for context menu (promote, declare, claim). Action validation feedback: legal move highlighting (green), illegal shake animation (red). Supports all ActionTypes in the schema.
